TECH_TIMEOUT.description: Run exceeded the configured timeout threshold

TECH_OOM.description: Out-of-memory or RSS exceeded hard ceiling

TECH_CORRUPTION.description: Data corruption or integrity check failure

TECH_CONFIG.description: Invalid configuration or missing required field

AGENT_REFUSAL.description: Agent refused to perform the requested action

AGENT_HALLUCINATION.description: Agent produced fabricated facts or references

AGENT_DRIFT.description: Agent response drifted from the original query intent

AGENT_FORMAT.description: Agent output violated the required format or schema

AGENT_TRUNCATION.description: Agent response was truncated or incomplete

AGENT_SAFETY.description: Agent triggered a safety filter or content policy block

MEM_RECALL_MISS.description: Memory recall failed to retrieve the target memory

MEM_RECALL_DRIFT.description: Memory recall returned an incorrect or off-topic memory

MEM_FORGET.description: Previously stored memory was lost or not persisted

MEM_CONSOLIDATION.description: Memory consolidation or merging produced incorrect results

MEM_DUPLICATE.description: Duplicate memory was created instead of updating existing

PASS.description: Run completed successfully with no failure
